# Go toolchains for CI, read by .github/scripts/setup-go.sh.
# Format: <key> <os>-<arch> <Go version in the archive's VERSION file> <archive URL> <sha256>
#
# setup-go.sh picks the line for the key and the runner's platform.
#
# The MetaCubeX/go `build` release holds one patched toolchain per Go minor
# version and replaces the assets in place when it is rebuilt. When that
# happens setup-go.sh fails with a SHA-256 mismatch: look at what changed in
# the release, then put the new version and digest here
# (`gh release view build -R MetaCubeX/go --json assets`).
#
# loong64-abi1 is the Go 1.26.0 toolchain that builds for the old LoongArch
# ABI (the loong64-abi1 release target); it only runs on linux-amd64.
# MetaCubeX/loongarch64-golang has no newer 1.26.x release yet (2026-10-17).
1.26 linux-amd64 go1.26.10 https://github.com/MetaCubeX/go/releases/download/build/go1.26.linux-amd64.tar.gz c1278af2579c9398cf22c638686e5348926b160eda784930d416d95aaa7a9221
1.26 linux-arm64 go1.26.10 https://github.com/MetaCubeX/go/releases/download/build/go1.26.linux-arm64.tar.gz 0f40288cd4cb6e2d8c105da0ec94c428f253ba13f18ea7f3fe853572c426689f
